title: factdiff.py and kbgit.py read files at a revision with git show REV:PATH, which fails on long Windows paths
goal: factdiff.py and kbgit.py read a file at a revision with git cat-file blob (or git show with -- after the revision), never git show REV:PATH, which checks its argument as a file name and fails as "Filename too long" on Windows in a deep checkout; a test with a runner that fails every git show REV:PATH proves each reader, as TestHeldOnLongPaths does for ql_deliver.

run: import re,pathlib;hits=[f for f in ('_tools/factdiff.py','_tools/kbgit.py') if re.search(r'"show", f"\{', pathlib.Path(f).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))];assert not hits,hits
